name: H3 v2v injection truncation
plain: Keeps only the tail of a normal schedule so a video-to-video pass starts partway in. The node calls this the quality dial of its pipeline and offers named presets. It is a step-count crop, not a sigma target, so the sigma reached depends on the scheduler and the shift.
math: full = calculate_sigmas(sampling, scheduler, total_steps); run = max(1, round(total_steps·inject)); return full[total_steps − run:].

props.shape: tail crop of a named scheduler

providers.author: matlowai
providers.note: motion.py is 5565 lines; only this class read

providers.author: Starnodes2024
providers.note: _get_sigmas: total = steps/denoise, keep the last steps+1
